subject: Seasonal Buoy Program - Gulf - Port au Port - north, Northeast Gulf - north, St. Lawrence
text:
Seasonal Buoy Program - Gulf - Port au Port - north, Northeast Gulf - north, St. Lawrence
The seasonal decommissioning of Canadian Coast Guard navigational buoys and placing of winter spars in the commercial sector is underway in:
St. Lawrence
 Gulf - Port au Port - north
 Northeast Gulf - north.
Mariners are requested to contact the appropriate MCTS centre to inquire about the buoy tending operations status and/or to consult the Canadian Coast Guard website at the following address: navigation-electronique.canada.ca.
